title: Clínica Brisa: care, calmly
goal: They come back for the check-up their dentist set.
audience: The clinic's families and adults, with their kids.

home.name: The booking site
home.msg: «Book a first visit»: the site goes straight to choosing a day and a time.
home.rule: One action per screen; the appointment is booked on the month's calendar.
home.alt: Sample home page of the clinic with its booking button

wa.name: The clinic's WhatsApp
wa.msg: «My next appointment», «My estimates» and opening hours, with short answers; anything clinical goes to reception.
wa.rule: Administrative answers; a person takes any clinical question.

m: Your next appointment is on Tuesday at 10:30.

wa.alt: Sample chat answering about the next appointment

reminder.name: The 24-hour reminder
reminder.msg: A day before, the appointment reminder, for those who asked for it.
reminder.rule: Opting out stops the send and opens a task for reception to call.

m: Tomorrow at 10:30 you have an appointment at the clinic.
If you need to move it, reply to this message.

reminder.alt: Sample chat with the appointment reminder

receipt.name: The appointment slip
receipt.msg: A paper ticket with its stub: date, branch and dentist, just as reception sees them.
receipt.rule: The date in serif and the same details reception holds, so both talk about the same thing.
receipt.watch: Appointments that arrive with their slip
receipt.alt: Sample appointment slip with its stub

kids.name: Brisa Chicos
kids.msg: A memory game with the Brisitos, for the wait.
kids.rule: Cosmetic prizes, like the «Good memory» sticker, kept apart from appointments and treatments.
kids.watch: Games finished in the waiting room
kids.alt: Sample memory game with the Good memory sticker

control.name: The check-up already set
control.msg: «Your dentist has set a check-up for you to book. You can pick a time in the portal.»
control.rule: Two messages every 30 days at most; for a child, the message goes to their responsible adult.

m: Hi Ana, your dentist has set a check-up for you to book.
You can pick a time in the portal or reply to this message.

control.alt: Sample chat about a check-up already set

kit.name: The care kit
kit.msg: A box for daily care, taken home after the visit.
kit.rule: Handed over at reception; inside, the card with the next check-up.
kit.alt: Sample box of the clinic's care kit

again.name: Booking again
again.msg: «If you'd like to rebook the appointment that was cancelled, you can pick a time whenever it suits you.»
again.rule: Discreet messages: the panel stops urgency, fear, offers and clinical detail.
again.watch: Cancelled appointments that return to the calendar

p.subj: Your appointment, whenever it suits you
p.m: If you'd like to rebook the appointment that was cancelled, you can pick a time in the portal.

again.alt: Sample email to rebook an appointment

rules: Calm: hours and appointments, in simple words.
A person talks about anything clinical.
For kids, games with cosmetic prizes.
next: The QR code on the appointment slip, already written in its requirements.
source: The campaigns, the chat, the reminder and the slip are in DentalOS's repo, with simulated messages; the kit is the playbook's proposal.
